low_gain.qualification: Descriptive approximation over five deterministic points. Curvature remains; not a demonstrated exact exponential law or statistical uncertainty estimate.

high_gain.qualification: Descriptive fit on the specified high-gain interval; not an integration-error bound.

interpretation: Rapid approximately exponential rise at low gain, followed by a crossover toward the nearly linear high-gain dependence; no second exponential regime is inferred.
